name: @veltravia/sandbox-mock
description: Deterministic, offline Mock Sandbox Runtime for @veltravia/sandbox-core. DEVELOPMENT/CI ONLY - provides NO OS-level isolation and executes NO host code; behaviors (success/failure/timeout/output-limit/cancellation/resource-breach/prompt-injection payloads) are simulated logically for tests. A production runtime implements the same SandboxRuntime interface behind a hardened boundary.
